Medical & Surgical packaging

Medical & Surgical Packaging Solutions

Steam sterilizable Bactite and grid lacquer papers with bacterial barrier and self sealing properties for medical gloves, syringes, catheters and surgical sutures. Free from optical brighteners and engineered for steam, EtO and gamma sterilization, these medical grade papers hold a dependable bacterial barrier and a clean peel for surgical disposables. They are lint free, fluid repellent and high in dry and wet strength, trusted across hospital and device supply chains.
